summary: A 0-100 score for how much the Iranian people trust the resistance and its coalition supporters. It rises when civilians are protected, surrenders are accepted and aid is delivered; it falls when civilians or surrendered soldiers are harmed. It unlocks resistance support and selects the ending.

civilian_protected.per: civilian moved to safety or shielded from danger

surrender_accepted.per: regime soldier who surrenders and is treated fairly

defector_welcomed.per: regime soldier who defects and joins the resistance

aid_delivered.per: aid convoy that reaches its destination

civilian_harmed.per: civilian injured or killed by coalition or resistance action

civilian_infrastructure_damaged.per: hospital, water, power, archive or polling site damaged

aid_convoy_lost.per: aid convoy destroyed or turned back

detainee_mistreated.per: prisoner of war held or moved without care

rules: The enemy is the regime's security forces, never the Iranian people. Civilians are never targets.
Gains are capped per category per episode so one easy action cannot win the arc; penalties are not capped.
The score is clamped to 0-100 and carries into the next episode.
If civilian_harmed reaches civilianHarmFailCount in one episode, that episode fails and restarts from its last checkpoint.
Every event carries the sector it happened in so the debrief can show where trust was won or lost.

endings.summary: A free, elected civilian government takes office with the trust of its people.
An elected government takes office, but trust is thin and the peace is fragile.
The vote happened, but the transition is contested and the work is unfinished.

endingRule: At E08_ENDING pick the first ending, from highest minScore down, whose minScore is at most the current score.
